items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal went with a rise about 3.2 mg/dL smaller in real adults. In the synthetic program, a walk after dinner went with a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners than after earlier ones in the same person. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to avoid this.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 13.0 hours, and 50.0% of nights reached 13 hours. In the randomized program, adding the overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points.
